baseline_observation: 390x844 real Chrome retry center point resolves to a recommendation overlay instead of the retry button.

improvements.decision: Make only the non-actionable mobile recommendation surface click-through; preserve pointer events for recommendation buttons and summaries.
improvements.acceptance: At 390x844, 430x932, 768x1024, and 1616x923, retry owns its center hit point and a real click changes the retry notice while the NEXT CTA remains operable.
